desc: Ideate DP design: state (alt_sum, parity, product), bitset over sums per (parity, product), overflow sentinel limit+1, nonempty-only tracking
Implement bitset DP: layers[2] dicts {product: sum-bitset}, per-element snapshot transitions with shift by ±v and product clamp, singleton seeding, mask to sum range
Add early checks: |k| > sum(nums) → -1; offset = sum(nums); mask = (1 << (2*offset+1)) - 1
Final answer extraction: scan p from limit down to 0, check bit (k+offset) in layers[0].get(p) and layers[1].get(p), return max or -1

Test: three given examples plus edge cases — zeros in nums, overflow-then-zero (nums=[5,0], k=5, limit=1 → 0), single element, k=0 empty-subsequence trap, product exactly equal to limit; ~2000 randomized brute-force comparisons all matched
